items.question: What is an AI Presence Score?
items.answer: Your AI Presence Score is a quick, preliminary read on how visible your dealership is to AI. It highlights where you're strong, where you're being skipped, and the pages to improve so AI is more likely to recommend you.

items.question: Is the AI Presence Score really free?
items.answer: Yes. The preliminary AI Presence Score is free and comes with no obligation. Enter your name, email, and website URL and you'll get your results in about 30 seconds.

items.question: Why does AI visibility matter for my dealership?
items.answer: Fleet managers, owner-operators, and commercial buyers increasingly ask AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI who to trust for trucks, trailers, equipment, and parts instead of scrolling search results. If AI can't understand or find your dealership, you're left out of those recommendations.

items.question: What do I do if my score is low?
items.answer: A low score means AI struggles to find, understand, or recommend your dealership. Buzznerd optimizes your website and content so AI can — you can book a visibility demo to walk through exactly what to fix.

items.question: How long does the scan take?
items.answer: About 30 seconds. You'll see a preliminary score on screen, and we'll email the complete AI Presence Report with the details and the pages to prioritize.
